concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑001 (data ingestion) is claimed to be satisfied by tasks T000b and T012, but task T012 is absent from the task list.
Functional Requirement FR‑007 (missing‑data handling) references tasks T008, T013, and T014; tasks T013 and T014 are not present in the task list.
The requirement‑to‑task mapping table lists T013 and T014 as satisfying FR‑007, but these identifiers do not exist elsewhere in the document, creating stale tags.
Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires a task that generates and records checksums for raw data files; no such task appears in any phase.
Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) mandates a task that runs the Reference‑Validator on all citations; the task list contains no task performing this validation.
The implementation plan (plan.md) specifies a quick‑start guide (quickstart.md) as an output, yet there is no task that creates or updates this documentation.
Task identifier T007b is used for both the synthetic CSV generator and its contract test, violating the unique‑identifier rule and potentially causing ambiguity.
